fullRevision:
Precise editing of the supplied three-panel watercolor game-level sheet. Preserve THREE panels A B C, original side-on orthographic camera, tiny ivory flame spirit scale, damp garden brick drain, roots, moss, soft ink watercolor, main hanging pulley mechanism and tail scale in panel C. Apply these four corrections carefully.
1. REMOVE EVERY MAN-MADE LANTERN, including the overhead source in panels A and B and the small decorative lantern on the lower floor in B. Replace the overhead source, in the same place in BOTH A and B, by the SAME imaginary SUBTERRANEAN BIOLUMINESCENT BULB growing out of the earth above the vault. A palm-sized-to-human organic tuber, very large relative to the tiny spirit: ivory amber translucent layered fleshy bulb, branching roots embedded in soil, green-brown enclosing bracts with a downward opening. NO metallic housing, no glass lantern, no electric cord. One warm luminous inner core. Its thick bracts form a natural downward light opening; a clear narrow golden puzzle beam exits straight DOWN to the existing slanted reflector. Thin living roots replace the old shutter cable back to the left interaction point, where a reachable knotted root can be touched to unfurl the bracts. Do not add decorative luminous mushrooms or other lamps. The former B lower-floor lamp becomes ordinary non-luminous moss and a leaf.
2. PANEL A crossing MUST require the suspended counterweight step. DELETE ALL stepping stones, short brick columns, little shelves, planks, ladders and walkable ledges in the water DIRECTLY UNDER and between the left and right banks of the counterweight crossing. Specifically the broad central lower cluster around 40–68 percent of panel width. Show one unbroken open dark water slot between the sheer sides of the two banks. No visible floor or submerged stones can connect the banks. The clear unsupported gap is about 3.6 spirit-heights, well beyond a normal 2H jump. The hanging flat counterweight step in its MIDDLE position is the ONLY intermediate foothold, making two short jumps possible. Keep it just slightly higher than the left takeoff ledge and slightly lower than the right landing ledge. No additional platform below it. Preserve original warmup platforms OUTSIDE this crossing on the far left.
3. PANEL B, the object at the high light beam crossing the CENTRAL brick pier must be a plain, unmistakable rectangular HOLE THROUGH MASONRY. Remove any reflective oval, metal rim, glowing jewel or bright shiny border there. Show a dark through-hole with rough matte brick jambs and the same straight horizontal beam passing through unchanged. There is exactly ONE reflector in B, the sloping reflector on the height-changing mechanism at far left; no additional mirror in the central wall. Do not bend the horizontal beam at the hole.
4. Reconstruct B's middle traversal shelves into an ACTUAL SMALL SWITCHBACK, not a decorative random maze. Keep upper winch and broad starting ledge at left. The route first moves right on a LOWER ledge, below the middle pier. It reaches the right end of that ledge and hops UP-RIGHT onto a short stone bracket. Then two separate brackets climb BACK LEFT (each slightly higher than previous), and finally a higher bracket allows a hop BACK RIGHT onto the UPPER gallery leading to panel C. This is a compact stair-shaped serpentine sequence around the central pier: right, up-left, up-left, up-right, right. Platforms must be distinct, flat, outlined and sized to the tiny spirit; each mandatory jump roughly 0.8–1.2 spirit-heights horizontally and 0.8 spirit-heights upward. Lower and upper continuous gallery floors are separated by about 3 spirit-heights, so the upper gallery cannot be reached immediately. Avoid an accidental direct rising staircase from the starting winch to the upper exit. DO NOT draw arrows yet.
Keep C mostly unchanged except remove any lantern if present. Revise the short captions to exactly: “A 唤醒球茎 · 配重过闸”, “B 升镜送光 · 错层折返”, “C 窄台摆渡 · 抵达光鳞”. Maintain quiet readable composition, beautiful watercolor, no browser UI, no green user markings, no long paragraphs.
flowDetail:
Create a NEW ENLARGED B-PANEL DETAIL based on the MIDDLE panel of the reference sheet, with a corrected, actually legible playable switchback and movement arrows DRAWN DIRECTLY ON THE SCENERY. Output one wide landscape 1536x864 diagram (approximately 16:9), NOT the whole three-panel sheet. Retain the same watercolor/ink underground brick garden drain, roots, teal shadows, tiny ivory big-head flame spirit, upper winch at left, and the newly organic luminous bulb growing from overhead roots. No man-made lamps.
The previous platform geometry did NOT demonstrate the route. Rebuild the PLAYABLE foreground to this explicit side-view layout. Keep background masonry quieter. These coordinates are a layout reference for a 1536x864 image, scale to output proportionately. Character standing height ~60 px. Flat walking surfaces are shown by their TOP pixel y, higher means smaller y:
START broad winch platform: x160..430, top y560. Tiny hero stands here. One downward transition ledge x470..570, top y592.
LOWER APPROACH LANE: x610..955, continuous horizontal walkable top y640. This long low ledge runs UNDER the return shelves. Its top must be clear for WALKING. No solid columns from the shelves above may block the lane.
RIGHT TURN STEP number 2: x1020..1100, top y588. This is a separate short wall-supported stone bracket above-right of the end of lower lane.
BACK-LEFT STEP number 3: x890..960, top y536.
BACK-LEFT STEP number 4: x745..825, top y484.
TURN-RIGHT STEP number 5: x895..975, top y432.
UPPER CONTINUE STEP number 6: x1040..1120, top y432.
EXIT GALLERY: x1190..1470, top y432, continues out of right frame toward C.
These are the ONLY traverse-support surfaces in the central area. The number 3,4,5,6 shelves are CANTILEVERS attached to the REAR wall with discreet brackets, not floor-to-ceiling piers that block the route underneath. No extra footholds between lower and upper lanes that could bypass the switchback. Lower continuous lane to upper gallery difference is ~208 pixels, over three spirit heights. Adjacent required rises are ~52px, slightly less than one spirit height; horizontal required gaps ~60–70px. Quiet shallow water and broken nonwalkable background below, no alternate complete route.
OPTICS: giant-to-spirit natural glowing root bulb at x210,y100, emitting a narrow beam vertically DOWN from its bract opening to the ONLY sloping mirror at x210,y260. Mirror is in HIGH setting. A horizontal golden beam goes RIGHT at y260 to frame edge, through one plain dark RECTANGULAR THROUGH-HOLE around x900,y260 in a rear brick rib. Hole has rough matte brick edges, no shiny mirror or gold rim. Label near the hole “透光孔：不改变光向”. Keep this optical line ABOVE and visually distinct from player route.
DRAW PLAYER FLOW directly on this scene using thin clearly visible lines with arrowheads and numbered circular badges:
CYAN with ivory edge, label “① 下层向右”: from hero across first downward hop, then across the lower lane from x635 to x935, then an UP-RIGHT jump arc to STEP 2. Badge 1 belongs at lower lane, badge 2 at first right turn step.
CORAL PINK with ivory edge, label “②→④ 向左上折返”: jump arc from LEFT edge of STEP 2 to STEP 3, then LEFT again to STEP 4. Each arc visibly starts and lands on an actual shelf top. Badge 3 at back-left step and 4 at the upper-left step.
VIOLET with ivory edge, label “④→⑥ 上层向右”: jump arc from RIGHT edge of STEP 4 to STEP 5, then RIGHT to STEP 6, then RIGHT to exit gallery. Put badges 5 and 6 on corresponding shelves.
Make walking parts straight arrows just above ground and jumps discrete CURVED arcs, never a huge curve floating in the room. Route must read a simple S: right along bottom, up-left twice, up-right and onward. No arrow into water, no teleport, no diagonal arrow through stone. Colored arrows must not overlap the golden light beam. One spirit only; no ghost duplicates.
Top slim ivory margin title “B段｜实际行走与跳跃流线”. Bottom slim ivory margin a compact legend “青色：下层向右　珊瑚色：向左上折返　紫色：上层向右　金色：光路”. Do not add other route variants. Beautiful matching watercolor environment with crisp playable edges and readable annotated geometry.

Resize/reflow the sheet vertically if necessary to accommodate B's less-wide aspect ratio; do not crop away the source, the main route or exit.
